hero.subHeading: Personalized Care for Your Best Health, Energy, and Confidence
hero.sub: At RefynMe Medical Aesthetics and Wellness, every care plan is built around your unique goals — from medical weight management to aesthetic treatments. We combine compassion, clinical expertise, and evidence-based medicine so you can look, feel, and live your best.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.heading: Care that goes
mission.body: We are dedicated to helping patients look, feel, and live their best through individualized, evidence-based care — delivering safe, effective, and compassionate treatment that builds lasting wellness and confidence.

trust.yearsLabel: years in the healthcare industry serving the community
trust.label: Meet Your Provider
trust.body: As a board-certified Nurse Practitioner rooted right here in Brockton, I combine clinical precision with genuine community care. You're not a number — you're a neighbor. And you deserve a provider who treats you that way.

panel1.label: 01 — Medical Weight Loss
panel1.body: Clinically prescribed programs built for your body and your life. GLP-1 injections, oral medications, and personalized dietary guidance — supervised by a medical professional who actually knows your name.

panel2.label: 02 — Aesthetic Services
panel2.body: Botox, dermal fillers, and aesthetic treatments administered by a board-certified NP. Not a technician with a certificate. A medical professional who understands anatomy.

maria.quote: I had been trying to lose weight for three years. She actually looked at my labs, asked about my life, and built a plan for me. I have lost 24 lbs and I finally feel like myself again.

keisha.quote: I was nervous about Botox but she made me feel so comfortable. She explained every step and the results are so natural. My coworkers keep asking what I am doing differently.

sandra.quote: Finally a provider who understands my skin tone and treats me like a person. Her medical background shows in everything she does. I will not go anywhere else.

signal.label: For Our Community
signal.heading: South Shore
signal.body: For too long, women across the South Shore have driven to Boston or Providence for care that should exist right here. Brockton. Stoughton. Easton. Bridgewater. You shouldn't have to travel an hour to see a provider who actually sees you. RefynMe was built so you don't have to.
